items.html: And behold, we shall also explain from where the Garon of ZA was generated at the time of the pregnancy. And the matter is that it was explained above, in this chapter, that the two first joints of the NH of Arich ascended to the place of the breasts of Bina, but the upper joint of the Yesod remained below, in its place, within the two Yesodot of Aba and Ima, coupling there as above. And a distance is found between the Yesod and the two upper joints of the NH, for there is always its place, the upper joint of the Yesod, in the middle of the two upper joints of the NH. And that place of the Yesod remained a space. And it is known that everything holy leaves there its Reshimo always, and it is found that from the power of that illumination of the Yesod that was there at first, from it the Garon of ZA was generated.
